🦊 Kidsy Support

Help for parents and teachers using Kidsy: Learn With Fun.

Get help or report a problem

Open a request on the Kidsy help page. Please say which device you use and what happened.

Common questions

How do I change the grade? Open Me → Profile.

How do I make an exam on certain material only? Open Exams → Build my exam, tick the material, choose how many questions and press Start.

How do I start the scores again? Open Me → Rewards → Reset. Each reset asks first.

What does Kidsy Full include? In the iPhone, iPad and Android apps, a Kidsy Full subscription unlocks Exams, Merola weekly words and Custom practice. Stories, levels and games stay free. Plans are monthly or yearly, and the first 7 days are free.

How do I cancel? On iPhone or iPad: Settings → your name → Subscriptions → Kidsy. On Android: Google Play → Profile → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions. You can also tap Me → Manage or cancel subscription in Kidsy. Cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date to avoid the next charge.

I subscribed on another device. How do I get Kidsy Full here? Sign in with the same Apple ID or Google account, open Me and tap Restore purchase.

How do I get a refund? Refunds are handled by Apple (reportaproblem.apple.com) or Google Play.

Does Kidsy work offline? Yes. Only word look-ups, translations and the optional online voices need the internet.

Privacy

Kidsy collects no personal information. Read the full privacy policy.
